items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Internal Products
items.location_text: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As Anthropic grows, more of the work our own teams do every day runs through internal software, and that software has to keep up. We are building that software, and we are building it Claude-first: Claude should take on as much of the repetitive, multi-step work as it safely can, and people decide what needs a human. We’re looking for Staff+ full-stack engineers to drive this work. You’ll build across the stack: the products people use and the agents that work alongside them. You’ll work directly with the teams who rely on what you build. Many of these workflows write to business-critical data, so correctness matters as much as speed. This is a greenfield opportunity: you’ll shape the underlying systems, ship agents that take real work off people’s plates, and design how people and agents get the right context to make good decisions. Key responsibilities Design and ship internal products end to end, from the data model to the UI, for workflows that teams across Anthropic depend on. Put Claude to work on real tasks, such as gathering the context a decision needs, drafting the next step of a multi-step process or keeping records consistent across the systems teams already use, and decide where an agent should act and where a well-designed UI is the better answer. Make agents safe to trust with real work: scoped access to data, guardrails, evals, audit trails, and clear points where a person confirms before anything happens. Build one set of shared capabilities that people and agents both use, exposed as APIs and MCP tools, so the same rules and approvals apply to whoever makes the call. Treat speed and polish as product requirements. Spend time with the people who use what you build, find where their work slows down, and remove those steps. Build for correctness. When a workflow writes to business-critical data, a mistake travels into other systems, so you’ll know where idempotency, reconciliation and audit trails matter and where they don’t. Integrate with the third-party systems teams already rely on, and build the layer on top of them where people and agents get their work done. Set technical direction for a product area over multiple quarters, lead engineers across teams through large, ambiguous projects, and make the engineers around you better through design reviews, code review and mentorship. Operate what you ship: own the reliability of the workflows people depend on and be on call for them. Minimum qualifications Experience shipping production software as a backend-leaning full-stack engineer, comfortable designing a data model, an API and the UI on top of them. Experience building software on LLMs or agents, and a point of view on when an agent should act on its own and when it should ask first. Experience leading the design and delivery of complex, user-facing products across the full stack, through requirements that shifted while you built. Experience designing for correctness and data integrity from the start, in systems where errors are costly and hard to undo. Experience working closely with non-engineering partners, turning ambiguous needs into clear requirements and reaching decisions together. Preferred qualifications Experience building internal tools or platforms that other teams rely on. A plus, not a requirement; strong product generalists are just as welcome. Experience taking an agent into production for a high-stakes workflow, including the evals and guardrails that made it safe to ship. Experience building a zero-to-one product, or rebuilding one that people already depended on every day. Experience building on top of third-party platforms through their APIs, and knowing when to extend a system and when to build your own. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all. We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. THE ROLE This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it. You will own our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute. Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions. This is a role for an engineer who leads from the front because that is where the work is, not because management was the next rung on the ladder. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and ship the control plane. You build alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle. - Grow the engineers, not just the software. You set the standard for ownership, remove the obstacles in their way, and coach them past their comfort zone until the work they ship surprises them. - Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am, and your engineers learn from how you do it. - Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets. - Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs. - Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback — the leadership work that never becomes someone else's job. - Define the team's processes and execution rituals as it grows. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write. - You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped. - You have run Kubernetes in anger — and ideally built parts of it: operators, schedulers, controllers. You understand what happens underneath it, and you have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it. - You have run GPU workloads on Kubernetes, or you are confident you can own that domain fast. - You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code other engineers depend on. - Extensive experience building backend or infrastructure systems. - You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users. - A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. THE ROLE A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters. Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe. This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on. But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install. - Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses. - Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first. - Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery. - Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring. - Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it. - Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram. - 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction. - Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer. - You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped. - Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it. - A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Engineering Manager, Serverless Containers
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all. We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. THE ROLE This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it. You will lead the team building our serverless containers product: the way developers run AI apps, MCP servers, APIs, and managed workers on our cloud without thinking about servers. Push a container, get an endpoint, scale from zero to thousands of instances and back down — across CPU and GPU. On a hyperscaler, the serverless layer is a product someone else built. Here you own it end to end: the scheduler that decides where a container lands, the routing path a request takes, the machinery that turns a scaled-to-zero service into a warm instance before a customer notices. All of it runs on metal, network, and datacenters we own. That tension is the product: scale-to-zero economics with cold starts in milliseconds, autoscaling that absorbs a launch spike without a config change, GPUs scheduled onto containers the way other platforms schedule CPU. The customers betting on this layer are the developers building the next generation of AI software on European infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own the container platform end to end: image delivery, placement, request routing, scale-up, scale-to-zero — across CPU and GPU. - Make cold starts a solved problem: snapshotting, prewarming, image-layer caching, whatever it takes for scale-from-zero to feel instant. - Treat AI workloads as the normal case: GPU-backed containers, streaming responses, long-lived connections, MCP servers that cost almost nothing while idle. - Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions. - Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone. - Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback. - Partner with Product Managers to turn platform decisions into a product developers want to deploy on. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write. - You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped. - You have built container or workload platforms — orchestration, scheduling, isolation, request routing — not just deployed onto someone else's serverless platform. - Deep Linux: namespaces, cgroups, image layers, page cache — comfortable well below the application layer. - Multi-tenancy instincts: density, isolation, and fairness when hundreds of customers share one fleet. - Significant experience building complex backend or infrastructure systems. - You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users. - A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. items.title: Enterprise Success Manager, NL (EMEA)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As an Enterprise Success Manager at Mistral, you own what happens to our most strategic enterprise accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows, keep production ARR healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals Sales closes. Mistral's Solutions teams create high-value AI use cases with our customers. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, measuring its business impact, and scaling value across the organization. You will work with customer sponsors, business teams, IT and security stakeholders, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support. This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them): - Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing. - Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals. In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout, a motion already credited in a major European win. WHAT YOU WILL DO OWN THE CUSTOMER SUCCESS AND VALUE PLAN - Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes. - Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear. - Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative. MAKE DEPLOYMENT REALITIES PART OF THE SUCCESS PLAN - Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models. - Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders. - Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited. - Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments. DRIVE ADOPTION, AUTONOMY AND SUSTAINED VALUE - Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks. - Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement. - Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently. - Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes. DEFEND AND GROW THE COMMERCIAL RELATIONSHIP - Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time. - Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value. - Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks. BRING THE CUSTOMER VOICE INTO MISTRAL - Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner. - Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions. BUILD THE COMPANY AS WELL AS THE ACCOUNT - Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts. - Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions. - Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Delivery/Implementation, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical AI or SaaS environment. - Experience owning outcomes for enterprise customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting. - Strong technical fluency in enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premises, VPC, serverless) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and security reviews, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity. - Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security teams, while translating technical trade-offs into clear business implications for executives and users. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert. - Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion. - Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability. - Fluent English; professional French strongly preferred (a significant share of our enterprise base is French-speaking). NICE TO HAVE - Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments. - Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation. - Experience building adoption, change-management or customer education programs across large organizations. - Experience at a forward-deployed, solutions-led company. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Partner Marketing Lead, APAC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking a Partner Marketing Lead, APAC, reporting to the Global Head of Partner Marketing, to own partner marketing end to end across a region where partners are central to how Claude reaches enterprises. As our founding APAC Partner Marketing leader, you'll set the plan for the region rather than execute one set elsewhere: you'll build the operating model, carry partner pipeline goals, and turn our work with hyperscale cloud providers, global and regional systems integrators, resellers, and technology partners into a regional go-to-market motion that creates pipeline and drives adoption of Claude. The central challenge is sequencing: ANZ, ASEAN, India, Japan, and Korea differ in their partner ecosystems, buyers, languages, and maturity. In some, local partners are the main route to enterprise customers, and India's systems integrators also deliver for customers worldwide. You'll decide where to invest first, where a global or partner-led program is enough for now, and where to wait. This role calls for the seniority to lead a regional organization and the willingness to start hands-on with a very small team, defining the regional team plan and then hiring and managing the team as headcount opens. The role covers the whole region, including Japan, where you'll build on an established Partner Marketing presence, so that partners and sales teams experience one connected regional approach. Key responsibilities Set the APAC partner marketing strategy, annual plan, and investment priorities, aligned with global Partner Marketing, the regional Partnerships business plan, and APAC sales leadership Decide which markets and partners to prioritize, in what order, and through which motions, and revisit those choices as the business changes Represent Partner Marketing with regional and global leadership, and make clear recommendations on tradeoffs Build the regional operating model, including planning, intake, approvals, reporting, and how global programs are adapted for local markets Define the regional team plan and make the case for where to add capacity Hire, manage, and develop the team as headcount opens, and set the standard for partner marketing in the region Build a network of regional agencies and vendors to extend the team Build joint marketing plans with priority partners, starting with hyperscale cloud providers and their co-sell and marketplace motions, alongside global and regional systems integrators, resellers, and technology partners Equip partners to market and sell Claude on their own, with localized campaigns, content, and workshops they can run with their own teams and customers Lead the regional partner calendar, including joint campaigns, executive engagements, workshops, partner events, and regional partner summits Set pipeline and adoption goals with Partnerships and sales leadership, and take ownership of the results Connect partner activity to priority accounts and open opportunities so that partner and direct sales motions reinforce each other Build the regional pipeline of partner customer stories and public proof points Own the regional partner marketing budget and market development funds, with strong financial discipline and a focus on return Maximize partner co-investment and negotiate effectively with vendors Define how success is measured, including sourced and influenced pipeline and adoption of Claude, and use results to decide where to invest and what to stop Align the regional plan to the International Partnerships business plan, working with its leadership on overall goals and day to day with subregional and country partnerships leaders and partner managers Work with APAC sales leaders on account priorities and where partners can help open or advance deals Coordinate with APAC Field Marketing so that field and partner programs run from one regional plan Work with global Partner Marketing on partners that span regions, such as cloud providers and global systems integrators, as well as Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Communications, and Marketing Operations, and bring regional partner feedback back into their plans Minimum qualifications 14+ years of B2B enterprise technology marketing, with significant experience in partner or channel marketing Experience owning partner or channel marketing strategy for a region or multiple markets, including priorities and investment decisions Experience leading marketing programs across multiple Asia-Pacific markets, with strong awareness of how those markets differ Experience hiring and managing marketers, or clear leadership experience to build a regional team Experience building programs with cloud providers, systems integrators, resellers, or distributors, and an understanding of co-sell and partner-led pipeline Track record of contributing to significant pipeline or revenue goals, with strong analytics and attribution skills Experience managing substantial marketing budgets, including partner co-funding or market development funds Experience building programs and processes from the ground up, and willingness to do hands-on work while the team grows Ability to work effectively with sales leaders, partner executives, and senior stakeholders, and to move priorities forward with people you don't manage Ability to make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, and comfort with ambiguity Clear written and verbal communication with executive and regional audiences Care about the societal impacts of AI and about helping organizations adopt AI responsibly Preferred qualifications Experience building and scaling a partner or channel marketing function in APAC at an enterprise software or cloud company Experience leading marketing with cloud providers, systems integrators, and resellers or distributors, including owning the pipeline that came from that work Experience managing a regional team across several APAC markets in partner or field marketing Experience as the first partner or field marketing leader in a new region Experience marketing AI/ML or other complex technical products to enterprises Experience marketing with AWS, Microsoft, or Google Cloud in APAC, including co-sell and marketplace motions Experience launching or scaling a reseller or partner program Established relationships with partners, agencies, or industry organizations in the region Fluency in one or more Asia-Pacific languages Knowledge of regional regulatory and compliance requirements for marketing Experience using Claude or other AI tools to scale marketing work Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer, TRUST Network
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Travel Rule engineering operates the TRUST network, a critical piece of Travel Rule compliance across the industry. TRUST defines the protocols members use to securely exchange Travel Rule data with one another, and the team builds innovative solutions with impact well beyond Coinbase. We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction as TRUST grows from a small, bespoke network into the operating layer for Travel Rule compliance. You will make architectural decisions that hold across independently operated institutions while staying hands-on in design, code, and production operations. What you'll do: Define the short-term and long-term strategic vision for the TRUST network and sequence it into an engineering roadmap with Product. Lead architecture across the network: services, protocols, and integration patterns for member discovery, address registration, counterparty identification, and secure data exchange. Partner with product, legal, and compliance to translate a rapidly changing regulatory landscape into designs that hold up to scrutiny. Lead SDKs, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code templates with engineers across the industry to cut member onboarding from weeks to days. Establish network reliability practices and member-facing monitoring without exposing sensitive customer data. Raise the engineering bar by writing critical code, leading design reviews and incident retrospectives, and mentoring engineers. Required Skills and Experience: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including idempotency, retries, ordering, and partial failure across independently operated services. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams on multi-quarter projects with measurable outcomes. Experience owning production architecture for backend services: API design, asynchronous processing, data modeling, security, and observability. Ability to turn ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems into a technical strategy and explain trade-offs to technical and nontechnical partners. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . items.location_text: San Francisco, Remote (United States), London, Belgrade, New York City, Dublin
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Perplexity is building cybersecurity products where agents do the security work, not just assist with it. Our security team already runs agents on our own environment every day, across finding vulnerabilities, testing our defenses, securing our cloud, and responding to threats. Now we're turning that work into products for customers, and we expect those products to span application security, offensive testing, cloud security, detection and response, and areas we haven't picked yet. We're looking for a hands-on Software Engineer to build these products end to end, from the security logic and agent workflows to the integrations and product surfaces customers use. You'll ship to design partners and enterprise customers quickly, and you'll work directly with the security engineers who do this work internally, so what we build is grounded in real codebases, real environments, and real attackers. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build security products from zero to one across domains such as application security, penetration testing and offensive security, cloud security, and detection and response. - Build agents that do real security work: review code and find vulnerabilities, test applications and infrastructure like an attacker, assess cloud configurations, and investigate threats, then validate findings and recommend or apply fixes. - Build the systems underneath: multi-tenant services, data pipelines, and secure execution environments that run against customer code, cloud accounts, and telemetry. - Build integrations with the tools customers already use: source control and CI/CD, cloud providers, identity providers, security tools, ticketing, and chat. - Ship the product surfaces customers use: APIs, dashboards, onboarding, and workflows that fit how security and engineering teams actually work. - Hold the product to the same standard we hold ourselves: strong tenant isolation, least privilege, safe handling of customer secrets and data, and tight controls on any agent that acts in a customer environment. - Define how we measure quality (finding accuracy, false positive rate, exploitability, time to fix, cost) and use it to drive improvements. - Work directly with design partners and customers, and help decide which security problems we should build products for next. QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years of experience as a software engineer building production systems, with meaningful time spent on security products, security data platforms, or security engineering with heavy software development. - Proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or Rust) and experience owning production services end to end. - Hands-on depth in at least one security domain, such as application security, penetration testing or offensive security, cloud security, or detection and response, and curiosity to work across the others. - Experience integrating with security- or developer-relevant systems such as source control, CI/CD, cloud provider APIs, identity providers, scanners, or SIEMs. - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and building secure, multi-tenant SaaS. - Comfortable working directly with customers and shipping pragmatic improvements quickly in an ambiguous, early-stage product area. - Bonus: experience building LLM-powered agents, evaluation frameworks, or tool-using automation for security or other high-stakes domains. - Bonus: experience at a security product company (AppSec, pentesting, cloud security, detection and response) or on an internal security platform at scale.

items.title: Project Manager - Automation & AI
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE PIA is LeoVegas Group’s AI Process Improvement & Automation hub. Using AI agents, RPA and process change, we redesign how work gets done in a regulated iGaming environment. As Project Manager for AI Process Improvement and Automation, you’ll report to the Head of PIA, deliver PIA’s AI and automation projects, and coordinate PIA’s workstream within the wider AI Programme. PIA’s delivery team, led by the PIA Manager, builds the solutions. Your role is to take each initiative from intake to realised value: making sure the right things get built, with the right owners and the right controls in place, and that people actually use them. The role is roughly 70% hands-on delivery and 30% workstream coordination. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Running intake and prioritisation with business stakeholders, and challenging any request that lacks a business owner, data or clear dependencies before work begins - Leading multiple AI and automation projects end to end, from business case through to post-go-live benefit tracking (hours saved, revenue gained, risk reduced) - Driving adoption and change management, because an automation nobody uses is a failed project - Keeping PIA’s AI Programme workstream plan up to date, managing risks and dependencies across teams, and reporting progress to the Programme Board - Building the right controls into every project plan from the start, including CoE sign-off, Legal and InfoSec review, and EU AI Act obligations where relevant - Keeping project documentation and status transparent in Jira and Confluence OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - 4+ years in project delivery, including automation, AI or digital transformation projects through to real adoption - A working understanding of AI and automation (generative AI, RPA, low-code, agentic workflows): strong in at least one, curious about the rest, and able to challenge delivery teams on feasibility - Experience measuring benefits after go-live, not just milestones - Ability to push back on stakeholders and prioritise by value - Fluent English, written and spoken WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - Employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments - Free parking CALL TO ACTION In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride – give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Role Summary : Associate AI Deployment Strategist As an Associate AI Deployment Strategist, you will support the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI solutions, working closely with customers and internal teams to bridge the gap between strategic vision and practical implementation. This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn, grow, and contribute to transformative AI projects in a collaborative environment. You will assist in designing AI roadmaps, collaborating with the Solution team to deliver solutions, and ensuring smooth transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to customer success, helping turn AI potential into real-world impact. What you will do Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting • Assist in executive-level workshops to identify business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive improvements. • Support the creation of AI adoption roadmaps, helping articulate the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value. • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases and align solutions with customer objectives. AI Solution Design & Deployment • Contribute to the design and deployment of end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer workflows. • Prototype and deploy AI solutions, ensuring scalability and impact under supervision. • Executing pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology. Value Realization & Customer Success • Support customers in their AI strategy, helping them maximize the value of their investment in Mistral. • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to business outcomes and assist in communicating progress to stakeholders. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Act as a liaison between customers and Mistral’s internal teams, gathering feedback to influence product and research roadmaps. • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment. About you • 1 to 2 years in a client-facing strategic role (e.g., management consulting, value engineering, or technical sales). To note, we also accept fresh graduates that have gained relevant experience through internships and work study programs. • You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.) • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure challenges into actionable solutions. • Effective communication skills to engage with stakeholders at various levels. • Strong technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science • Hands-on experience prototyping proofs-of-concept (Python, JavaScript, or similar) • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment. Why this role matters You will play a key role in supporting how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By collaborating with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, contributing to Mistral’s growth and customer success. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in the AI industry. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
items.location_text: London, New York, Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE We're seeking a Senior/Staff Engineer to build and maintain the automation infrastructure that powers the development cycles of our North platform. This engineer will design and implement robust automation systems that enable engineers to efficiently test and validate changes across diverse environments and configurations. This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure and standards. You'll build the systems, frameworks, and culture that allow the rest of engineering to own quality themselves; improving and extending our testing platform by creating the infrastructure that allows engineers to write and execute tests, and enable every engineering team to ship with more confidence. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Design and implement automation pipelines that support comprehensive testing across multiple environments with varying feature flags and realistic customer data profiles - Create intelligent testing agents that simulate real user behavior to validate different configuration combinations - Develop and maintain GitHub workflows and actions to automate testing, deployment, and validation processes - Manage and optimize Helm charts for deployment consistency across environments - Implement and maintain ArgoCD workflows for continuous deployment and environment management - Establish best practices for testing methodologies and ensure adoption across engineering teams - Build scalable infrastructure that supports parallel test execution across diverse configurations - Develop infrastructure-as-code templates and configurations for reproducible test environments - Implement containerization strategies for test environments and dependencies - Create benchmarking frameworks to measure performance and reliability across different configurations - Monitor and improve test coverage and reliability metrics - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand testing requirements and translate them into automated solutions - Troubleshoot and resolve complex testing infrastructure issues REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on automation and testing infrastructure - Expert proficiency in Python and TypeScript - Extensive experience with GitHub workflows and actions - Deep understanding of testing methodologies and best practices - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines - Containerization experience (Docker, Kubernetes) - Benchmarking experience and performance testing methodologies - Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) - Background in developer tools or platform engineering - Ability to design and implement complex automation systems - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience working with LLMs in production environments - Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code principles - Experience with container orchestration and management - Knowledge of performance testing tools and frameworks - Experience with monitoring and observability tools - Background in test framework development - Strong working knowledge of Helm charts and ArgoCD - Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) WHAT YOU'LL BUILD You'll enhance our testing platform to allow engineers to: - Spin up environments with specific feature flag combinations using infrastructure-as-code - Load test configurations with realistic customer data volumes in containerized environments - Run comprehensive test suites across multiple environment configurations with automated benchmarking - Generate detailed performance and reliability reports across different cloud environments - Automatically detect and flag regressions in diverse usage scenarios - Scale testing infrastructure to accommodate our growing customer base This is a critical role for ensuring the reliability and scalability of our North platform as we continue to grow our customer base and expand our feature set. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of our development infrastructure and make a significant impact on product quality. (edited) FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: US Filings Lead
items.description: US Filings Lead Location: New York, NY (in office strongly preferred) Type: Full-Time About Polymarket Polymarket is the world’s leading prediction markets platform and a CFTC-regulated designated contract market. We let people trade on real-world events, from political elections to sports outcomes to macroeconomic data releases, turning any question about the future into a tradeable contract. We’re building a new kind of information layer: fast, precise, and financially incentivized. Our markets have become a primary source of real-time probabilistic truth for millions of users. Now we’re looking for domain experts who can own what matters and ensure Polymarket is always first to cover it. The Role We’re hiring a US Filings Lead to work at the intersection of markets, compliance, and legal at Polymarket US. You’ll own the CFTC 40.2 self-certification and 40.6 rule amendment pipeline end to end, and work with the Markets team to structure new markets so they are both tradeable and certifiable. This role requires understanding how markets work, not just how to file them: contract design, market structure, and the economic impact of fees and incentives, alongside the regulatory requirements. You’ll report to Compliance and work day to day with the Markets team in New York. What You’ll Do - Work with the Markets team on new markets from the start: contract terms, settlement sources, and resolution criteria - Work with our compliance, fraud, surveillance, and market operations teams to design the infrastructure to build and surveil event contracts, futures, and perpetuals. - Draft and own 40.2 and 40.6 filing packages that hold up to CFTC review under the CEA and DCM Core Principles - Own filings for fees and incentive programs and understand how each affects liquidity and trading - Run the compliance-review gate - SLead high-stakes regulatory strategy and represent Polymarket US in complex negotiations with CFTC Division of Market Oversight (DMO) and Division of Clearing and Risk (DCR) staff, defending novel contract structures and preempting formal stays or disapprovals (e.g., Part 40.11 reviews) - Track listings and filings across the industry and flag what matters for us and why - Keep templates and the filing catalog current, and use AI and automation to speed up drafting, review, and the filing pipeline -Architect the regulatory pathways for first-of-their-kind products—including event contracts, crypto derivatives, and perpetuals—translating ambiguous or evolving CEA interpretations into scalable, defensible market frameworks. -Partner directly with Executive Leadership, Product, and Legal to evaluate commercial trade-offs, advise on regulatory risk appetite for high-profile markets, and inform long-term exchange roadmap decisions. What You Bring - 7-12+ years at a DCM, SEF, DCO, FCM, or derivatives firm, or in a legal or regulatory practice serving them - Hands-on experience with CFTC certifications, rule filings, or exchange rulebooks - Strong grasp of market structure - Working knowledge of the CEA, CFTC Part 40, and the DCM Core Principles - Clear, precise writing for regulators and internal teams - Ability to balance quality and rigor with speed - Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work - Smart, reliable, low-ego, high-precision Nice-to-Haves - JD, or a background in trading or market structure - Experience with event contracts or prediction markets - Direct experience working with CFTC staff - Experience automating document workflows (AI tools, SQL, scripting) Submit the following alongside your resume: - Why US Filings Lead at Polymarket US? - A writing sample or paragraph on one of Polymarket US’s public filings and how you would draft it differently. Job Description Summary - Mission: get new markets listed quickly, with filings that are correct, on time, and survive CFTC scrutiny - What you own: the 40.2/40.6 filing pipeline end to end; the regulatory side of market, fee, and incentive design; templates and the compliance-review gate - Reports to: Compliance; works day to day with the Markets team - Location: New York, in office - Success at 6–12 months: zero filing defects reaching the CFTC; faster turnaround; brought in at the design stage, not the filing stage; templates fully current

items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Our Certification team sits within Legal & Compliance and makes sure every game and platform component LeoVegas Group launches is properly certified for each regulated market we operate in. As Senior Certification Specialist, you’ll be the team’s subject-matter expert: leading complex certification and audit projects, owning our day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs and setting how the team certifies across markets, so launches stay on track and the Group’s licences stay protected. You’ll work closely with the Gaming, Casino, Change Management and Technical Compliance teams, as well as external test labs and game suppliers, and report to the Certification Manager. It’s a role with real ownership and variety: you’ll shape procedures, turn regulatory and technical-standard changes into practical requirements, and help build the capability of the wider team by mentoring Certification Specialists and Officers. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Lead end-to-end certification and audit projects for games, platform and critical components across our regulated markets - Own day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes, timelines and escalations - Act as the senior escalation point for complex certification issues raised by the business and the certification team - Monitor regulatory and technical-standard changes and turn them into clear certification requirements - Review certificates and test reports for gaps and agree corrective actions with labs and game suppliers - Plan certification timelines with stakeholders so certification never blocks a launch - Own and improve internal certification procedures, market checklists and post-certification reviews - Mentor Certification Specialists and Officers and share jurisdiction knowledge across the team OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - In-depth knowledge of certification requirements for online gambling across multiple regulated markets - Extensive experience working with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes and resolving findings - Solid understanding of online gambling games and platforms, including game, platform and critical-component certification - Proven ability to run many certifications in parallel against fixed launch dates - Experience monitoring regulatory change and assessing its impact on certification NICE TO HAVES - Experience mentoring or coaching others - Confident user of Jira, Confluence or similar tracking tools WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! items.description: ABOUT MEDIALICIOUS At Medialicious, we're a global growth marketing partner powering the expansion of fast-growing social gaming brands. Headquartered in Gibraltar, our mission is simple: to be the industry leader through deep domain expertise, constant innovation, and strategic scale. Working hours: 9AM - 6PM (UTC-5) THE ROLE We are seeking a strategic Senior Creator Manager to set multi brand strategy across multiple markets. You will work alongside Head of Media and Partnerships to develop the long-term creator strategy for our portfolio of brands, shaping how creators drive brand growth, audience expansion, and business performance. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - You'll build the creator strategy from the ground up, defining the right portfolio mix of macro, mid-tier, micro, streamers and influencers to hit brand and performance goals. - You'll design the operating model that makes it repeatable: sourcing frameworks, contracting, compensation models, content guidelines and performance levers. - You'll run the full creator lifecycle — sourcing, vetting, negotiation, briefing, activation, optimisation and iteration — and keep output predictable. - You'll build the reporting and tracking setup that connects soft awareness metrics through to clicks, conversions, CPA and ROAS. - You'll own a rigorous testing agenda across formats, hooks, creators and integrations, on both paid and organic distribution. - You'll partner with Performance, CRM, Creative, BI/Analytics and Product, and make sure every piece of creator content is compliant with platform, regulatory and market rules for social casino. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - A proven track record leading influencer, creator or streamer programmes end to end — ideally in gaming, social casino, iGaming, entertainment or mobile apps. - Demonstrated success running performance-driven creator programmes against hard KPIs (CTR, CPV, CPA, ROAS). - Deep hands-on expertise in creator analytics, audience assessment, brand safety and performance evaluation. - Sharp negotiation, communication and partnership management skills — you've built long-term relationships with talent, agencies and management teams. - Highly organised and proactive, comfortable leading several initiatives at once in a fast-moving environment. - Fluent English, plus a genuine passion for gaming, streaming culture and US creator trends. - Why you will love it We're small, fast and allergic to bureaucracy. You'll have real ownership from day one, direct access to decision-makers, and the freedom to build something properly good rather than sit in meetings about it. How we work: open communication in Slack (not hidden in DMs), outcomes documented in Monday.com http://Monday.com, deadlines we actually agree and keep, cameras on for calls because we like feeling connected, and communication that says it in 20 words, not 1,000. Our values are simple — PASSION and PERFORMANCE. We love the product, we want to work with the best, we hold each other accountable, we choose progress over perfectionism, and we have a strict no-arsehole policy. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote. Contract: Full-time, permanent. Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead the global build and technical integration of Full MVNO systems. In this role, you will lead a dedicated Build Team responsible for architecting, integrating, testing, and commissioning end-to-end Full MVNO capabilities across global markets. Operating under a Build-to-Run model, you and your team will build new MVNO capabilities and host MNO integrations from the ground up, execute rigorous testing, and hand over stable, operational systems to a dedicated Run team after launch.
